concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR‑004 (multiple‑comparison correction) is not referenced by any task; no task implements or tests the Benjamini‑Hochberg correction.
Functional Requirement FR‑006 (pilot‑study human‑rating correlation) has no associated task; the pipeline lacks a task that ingests human ratings and computes the Pearson correlation.

Functional Requirement FR‑008 (process real‑human data for final hypothesis) is not covered by any task; there is no task that explicitly distinguishes real‑human data from synthetic data during final analysis.

Success Criterion SC‑001 (individual Pearson correlations for entropy, variance, object count) is missing; task T074 is absent, so the required CSV `individual_metric_correlations.csv` cannot be produced.
Success Criterion SC‑002 (p‑value for visual‑complexity ↔ NASA‑TLX correlation) is missing; task T054 is absent, leaving the correlation result unmeasurable.
Success Criterion SC‑003 (reaction‑time difference analysis) is missing; task T053 is absent, so the required `rt_diff.csv` cannot be generated.
Success Criterion SC‑004 (multiple‑comparison correction) is not linked to any task; although BH correction code exists (T040/T040a), no task is tagged with SC‑004 to verify its execution.
User Story 2 baseline reaction‑time measurement (FR‑002b) lacks a concrete task; T028a is missing, so no JSON `rt_measurements.json` will be produced.
Baseline order enforcement (FR‑002c) is not implemented; task T028b is missing, breaking the required guarantee that the baseline task precedes experimental trials.
Server implementation for presenting clips and recording NASA‑TLX (FR‑002) is absent; task T029 is missing, so the main‑study session cannot be run.
Flagging of incomplete records (FR‑002) is not covered; task T030 is missing, leaving records with missing TLX/RT unflagged.
Participant‑session CSV storage (FR‑002c) is not implemented; task T031 is missing, so the required `participant_sessions.csv` will not be generated.
Task‑difficulty metadata generation (FR‑002c) is absent; task T055 is missing, so `clip_difficulty.csv` will not exist.
Handling of images with zero detectable objects (FR‑001) is not covered; task T020 is missing, risking undefined `object_count` values.
Persistence of the metrics CSV (`data/processed/metrics.csv`) required by FR‑001 is not covered; task T021 is missing.
Dataset version & source recording for fetched stimuli (T032a) is missing; no `dataset_manifest.json` is produced, violating Constitution Principle VI.
Clip checksum manifest generation (T032b) is missing; `clip_manifest.json` is absent, breaking stimulus provenance.
Curated meeting‑background generation (T032c) is missing; `curated_clips.csv` and its manifest are not created, preventing proper data hygiene.
Infrastructure directory‑creation tasks T001a and T001b remain undone; while low severity, they impede traceability to FR‑001 and FR‑002.
Reproducibility orchestrator sub‑tasks T048a‑T048c are incomplete; without them the project cannot fully satisfy Constitution Principle I.
